subject.title: fix: bound Codex Telegram turns fail after /codex bind on OAuth refresh

question: After auditing the current `../codex` refresh-request contract, do these focused tests still cover the canonical shared-client and turn-attempt paths on the rebased head?

options.title: Audit and keep tests
